King Luther Capital Management Has Decreased Position in Apple Computer (AAPL) by $762,021; Natixis Has Cut Its Stake in Teva Pharmaceutical Inds LTD (TEVA) by $1.09 Million 
April 24, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson 
Natixis decreased its stake in Teva Pharmaceutical Inds Ltd (TEVA) by 56.48% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Natixis sold 60,287 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.04% with the market. The institutional investor held 46,460 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $865,000, down from 106,747 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Natixis who had been investing in Teva Pharmaceutical Inds Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $17.91B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.32% or $0.235 during the last trading session, reaching $17.615. About 5.71 million shares traded. Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited (NYSE:TEVA) has declined 49.50% since April 24, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 61.05% the S&P500. 
King Luther Capital Management Corp decreased its stake in Apple Computer Inc (AAPL) by 0.22% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. King Luther Capital Management Corp sold 4,509 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 2.07 million shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $350.36 million, down from 2.07M at the end of the previous reported quarter. King Luther Capital Management Corp who had been investing in Apple Computer Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $822.60B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.89% or $3.1199 during the last trading session, reaching $162.1201. About 23.93M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Since December 7, 2017, it had 0 buys, and 5 insider sales for $26.72 million activity. 39,122 shares were sold by Maestri Luca, worth $6.83 million on Thursday, April 12. SCHILLER PHILIP W had sold 69,491 shares worth $11.56 million.

Morgan Stanley maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on Tuesday, February 21 with “Overweight” rating. Deutsche Bank maintained the stock with “Hold” rating in Wednesday, August 2 report. As per Wednesday, August 2, the company rating was maintained by FBN Securities. Nomura maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Wednesday, July 5 report. The firm has “Hold” rating by KeyBanc Capital Markets given on Monday, June 5. The firm has “Buy” rating by Canaccord Genuity given on Thursday, September 14. The stock has “Buy” rating by Bernstein on Thursday, August 20. 
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1 after the close. They expect $2.71 EPS, up 29.05% or $0.61 from last year’s $2.1 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $13.75B for 14.96 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.33% negative EPS growth.
